about: Registry of Daniel Rosehill's public benchmarks and evals. Source of truth for the README table (scripts/build_table.py), the Hugging Face Space danielrosehill/My-Benchmarks and danielrosehill.com/ai/benchmarks. Edit this file, then run the script. Private repos are never listed.

built.label: Built
built.meaning: Repo, test material and harness exist; not yet fully run

prompts.label: Prompts only
prompts.meaning: Repo and published test prompts; no harness yet

planned.label: Planned
planned.meaning: Design only: a plan file, or a public repo with no test prompts yet

benchmarks.name: English–Hebrew Code-Switching ASR Benchmark
benchmarks.summary: Speech-to-text on English speech that contains Hebrew words: a frozen test set, runner, scorer and public leaderboard, comparing stock models with code-switching fine-tunes.

benchmarks.name: The PC Bench
benchmarks.summary: Does the model scold you? Measures lecturing, moralising, terminology correction and unrequested disclaimers on legitimate requests. 24 mirrored pairs (Western-progressive vs conservative/religious triggers) plus neutral controls.

benchmarks.name: Propaganda Bait Eval
benchmarks.summary: Feeds models loaded political premises across six series (CCP, MAGA, pro-Israel, pro-Palestine, Kremlin, US-progressive) and scores how readily each framing is repeated, with per-series selectivity.

benchmarks.name: Conspiracy Endorsement Eval
benchmarks.summary: Whether a model pushes back on, endorses or encourages 45 conspiracy theories, each asked in a curious and a believer framing. First hand-graded run (on-air-01): 7 models.

benchmarks.name: Israel–Palestine Framing Eval
benchmarks.summary: Whether a model treats mirrored pro-Israel and pro-Palestinian framings of the same events differently: loaded premises, framing pairs and open-neutral questions. First graded run (on-air-01): 6 models.

benchmarks.name: American Centrism Eval
benchmarks.summary: Whether a model assumes the user is in the US when nothing says so: geography, units, spelling, law and culture defaults, with controls.

benchmarks.name: Dan-Eval
benchmarks.summary: A composite of the model-behaviour checks I run before adopting a model for an app, giving one scorecard per model. Each component lives in its own repo.

benchmarks.name: Audio Understanding Bitrate Eval
benchmarks.summary: How MP3 bitrate affects transcription accuracy across every audio-input LLM on OpenRouter.

benchmarks.name: Whisper Fine-Tune Accuracy Eval
benchmarks.summary: WER of personal Whisper fine-tunes vs stock Whisper at each model size. Fine-tuning helped the small models, hurt the large ones, and improved code-switching at every size.

benchmarks.name: Whisper WPM & Background Noise Eval
benchmarks.summary: How speaking pace and background noise affect ASR word error rate.

benchmarks.name: Long-Form Audio Eval
benchmarks.summary: STT models on a 27-minute podcast against a professional reference transcript: WER, CER and punctuation accuracy.

benchmarks.name: One-Shot Transcription Microphone Eval
benchmarks.summary: STT accuracy across a range of microphones recording the same material.

benchmarks.name: Transcription Cleanup Eval
benchmarks.summary: Cloud audio-multimodal models transcribing and cleaning up a recording in one step. Subjective grading.

benchmarks.name: Local ASR STT Benchmark
benchmarks.summary: Whisper model sizes in Speech Note on Ubuntu with AMD/ROCm. A rough first-pass comparison.

benchmarks.name: Hebrew Image Generation Eval
benchmarks.summary: Twelve text-to-image models scored pass/fail on rendering Hebrew text correctly.

benchmarks.name: Gemma 4 Benchmarks
benchmarks.summary: Gemma 4 E4B vs Qwen3-VL 8B via Ollama on a CPU-only i7-12700F with 64 GB RAM.

benchmarks.name: Workstation Benchmarks
benchmarks.summary: Desktop workstation benchmarks (i7-12700F, RX 7700 XT, 64 GB DDR5, Ubuntu 25.10) with the full system inventory.

benchmarks.name: State Censorship in Asian Models
benchmarks.summary: State-aligned censorship and framing in Chinese and other Asian models.

benchmarks.name: US Partisan Framing Eval
benchmarks.summary: Asked a neutral question about a divisive US issue, does the model answer with the popular Democratic or Republican framing, and on foreign policy, hawkish or dovish? Blinded anchor-based grading, 14 topics plus factual controls.

benchmarks.name: Last-Hour News Recall
benchmarks.summary: Recall of the past hour's news by models that claim real-time retrieval.

benchmarks.name: Last-24-Hours News Recall
benchmarks.summary: Recall of the past day's news by models that claim real-time retrieval.

benchmarks.name: Tech Graphics Benchmark
benchmarks.summary: Lightweight periodic check of whether image models can make colourful, stylised tech diagrams with exact text and correct arrows. Text-to-image and image-to-image (whiteboard restyling), human-graded.
